# Breadcrumb

Breadcrumb shows where the current page is in the hierarchy and links to its parent pages. Use it on detail
pages several levels deep; the page title stays in the page header.

**Interaction**: links and buttons in the path are secondary text; hover adds the state layer, and `Tab` focus
shows the focus ring. The last item is the current page (`aria-current="page"`) and is not interactive. An item
with `menu` opens its dropdown menu on click or `Enter`, like Dropdown: focus moves into the menu and returns to
the item after closing.

**Category**: Basic · **Common uses**: Folder paths, the parent pages of a detail page, settings subpages

## Import

```ts
import { Breadcrumb } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      items={[
        { title: 'Projects', href: '#projects' },
        { title: 'Website redesign', href: '#projects/website' },
        { title: 'Mockups' },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Variants

### Buttons and menus

Items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons (for navigation inside the application); `menu` opens a
dropdown menu with sibling pages.

```tsx
export function Variants() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb
      items={[
        { title: 'Files', onClick: () => {} },
        {
          title: 'Design',
          menu: {
            items: [
              { key: 'design', label: 'Design' },
              { key: 'marketing', label: 'Marketing' },
              { key: 'finance', label: 'Finance' },
            ],
          },
        },
        { title: 'Brand assets', onClick: () => {} },
        { title: 'Logos' },
      ]}
    />
  )
}
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `readonly BreadcrumbItem[]` | The path from the top level to the current page; the last item is the current page and is not a link. Items with `href` are links; items with only `onClick` are rendered as buttons; items with `menu` are buttons that open a dropdown menu (such as sibling folders). | — | Yes |
| `aria-label` | `string` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark; the built-in text by default ("Breadcrumb"). | — | No |

Does not accept `style` or `className`: appearance is adjusted only through the semantic props above and the theme.
